product.description: Generic replacement HP TF03XL battery, 11.55V, Li-Polymer. Fits HP Pavilion 15-CC, 15-CD, 15-CK and Pavilion x360 14-BF, 14-CD series (3-cell, 41.9Wh). Also matches part numbers 920046-421, 920070-855, HSTNN-UB7J, HSTNN-LB7X. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits HP Pavilion 15-CC, 15-CD, 15-CK and Pavilion x360 14-BF, 14-CD series. Note this uses a different connector from the similarly-named HT03XL and is not interchangeable with it — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible battery?
faqs.answer: This is a generic (compatible) TF03XL-family battery, not an original HP unit.
